Exact crop of the published Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side), PDF page 28: the slip of [[Krayt Dragon Bones (V) (Errata 3)]] (official text as of 27 April 2013; PDF built February 2014). It prints errata version PC-E3 (“Deploy on table. Womp Rats are not [Selective Creature]. Once per turn, may ▼ a creature (except a parasite) or a dewback. Your ferocious creatures are deploy -2 and ferocity +1. Whenever you retrieve Force because a creature has eaten a card, you need only use X-2 Force for Aim High (to a minimum of 1). [Immune to Alter]”), word for word the text of [[Krayt Dragon Bones (V)]].<ref>[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Master List (Dark Side)]]. Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>
